pause_annotations.title: 1. One Pick attempt begins
pause_annotations.label: LOGGED FACTS
pause_annotations.annotation: The cube starts on the floor, on the robot side of the barrier. The bin is across the barrier. The gripper is commanded open.

pause_annotations.title: 2. The tool is close, but the cube has not lifted
pause_annotations.label: LOGGED FACTS
pause_annotations.annotation: At step 100, the tool is about 5.6 cm from the cube center. The cube remains at floor level. No close command has been issued.

pause_annotations.title: 3. Pick reaches its 230-step stopping limit
pause_annotations.label: LOGGED FACTS
pause_annotations.annotation: All 230 commands kept the gripper OPEN. The cube never rose above its initial height. The controller ended without withdrawing from the cube.

pause_annotations.title: 4. The model can judge failure, but not the next state
pause_annotations.label: ACTUAL MODEL OUTPUT
pause_annotations.annotation:
Termination: true
Pick success: false
State cluster: null
Reason: finger separation and clear top access were not established.

pause_annotations.title: 5. The generated state definitions leave a gap
pause_annotations.label: CONTRACT AUDIT
pause_annotations.annotation:
FREE requires the cube to be clear of the fingers.
PARTIAL GRASP requires closed or partly closed fingers.
This open-gripper endpoint fits neither with sufficient evidence.

pause_annotations.title: 6. Why practice cannot continue
pause_annotations.label: ALGORITHM BEHAVIOR
pause_annotations.annotation: OpenGripper is connected only to partial-grasp states. Human help also requires a resolved state. There is no recovery route from null; the session ends.

pause_annotations.title: 7. What still happened after the session
pause_annotations.label: RECORDED FOLLOW-UP
pause_annotations.annotation: The coding agent received this trajectory and revised Pick. The competence update was skipped because the destination was unknown. Task evaluation stayed 0/1 before and after.
